parameters.description:
`msg-to-matrix` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Matrix room — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own Matrix rooms — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Matrix rooms bound per enrollment.

In your Matrix client (e.g. Element), open Settings → Help & About → Advanced to copy your account's access token as MATRIX_TOKEN. Set MATRIX_ROOM to the room ID you want messages posted into (found under that room's Advanced settings, prefixed with !), and set MATRIX_TXN to any unique string of your choosing — Matrix uses it as a client-generated transaction ID to avoid duplicate delivery. UnitySVC then posts your message straight into that room via the Matrix Client-Server API.
parameters.gateway_body_template: {"msgtype":"m.text","body":{* _escape_json((_body.title or "")..(((_body.title or "")~="" and (_body.body or "")~="") and "\n" or "")..(_body.body or "")) *}}
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Matrix destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your Matrix homeserver
parameters.gateway_url_plus: ${ customer_secrets._MATRIX_BASE ?? https://matrix.org }/_matrix/client/v3/rooms/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.room_secret }} }/send/m.room.message/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.txn_secret }} }
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Matrix room by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

room_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Matrix room ID (URL-encoded); used by the gateway-plus transformer channel

token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's MATRIX_TOKEN value (same format as MATRIX_TOKEN)

txn_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Matrix transaction ID; used by the gateway-plus transformer channel
